verdict.rationale: The Trusted Agent Protocol spec says that when a merchant answers with an HTTP 402 response, the agent's signed Agentic Payment Container carries a payment IOU. After verifying it, the merchant can grant access and expect funds at settlement, which lets an agent pay without a checkout UI, backed by RFC 9421 agent signatures and a reference merchant-backend. Beyond that single spec passage, the per-call API monetization flow is undocumented, and the product carries an "in development and deployment" caveat. Missing for 10: a documented per-call or micropayment pricing and settlement model for APIs, server-side 402 SDK or middleware guidance, production fees (only "contact Visa"), and hands-on or independent corroboration of 402 flows.
